audit.whatIsWrong: diff HARD 8/10 and the tldr's 'classic Vlad counter — her R ignores your pool math' sit against a 51.51% Vladimir win rate, a packet chart giving Vladimir 4/7 stages, and the page's own content spikes[1] which says Sanguine Pool dodges Unleashed Power. The tldr contradicts the content layer on the page.
audit.why: Unleashed Power is a targeted barrage — pooling the cast denies it (as content already states). Lane is poke-heavy early, Vladimir-favored from 4-5 on per packet chart.
audit.corrected: tldr/report[0] reworded to remove the false 'R ignores your pool' claim; diff token left as-is (enum, mirror not audited) and flagged in notes.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer phases[3..6].side say Syndra while content win[3..6] and the packet chart say Vladimir — four rows render two answers.
audit.why: Grounded: empowered Transfusion sustain outpaces her poke by 4-5, pool dodges the R cast at 6, Riftmaker makes her burst insufficient, and late drain-tank Vlad outscales a pick mage.
audit.corrected: phases[3..6].side moved to Vladimir with matching whys and ratings; win[] untouched (already correct).

audit.why: Ability names all check out (Dark Sphere Q 7s/800, Scatter the Weak E 15s stun cone, Unleashed Power R 120/100/80 targeted barrage, P grants W true damage and R execute). Key interactions now stated: pool dodges the R cast; E stun requires the sphere line; missingInteractions (true damage bypasses MR, R execute threshold) folded into cooldowns/don'ts.
E 15s flat, Q 7s, R 120s early, own pool 28s — these are the actual windows.

audit.why: Hidden mechanics stated: pool untargetability beats the R cast; her P-upgraded W deals true damage so MR stacking is not the answer; R executes low targets — track the HP number. Whether stun applies through spell shield etc. is not in kit text — not asserted.
No kit-visible movement asserted for 26.15; not separately verified.
